Name: Kenneth's Monster Loot Addon
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]This is a small addon for Kenneth's Grocery Store. It puts 5 vanilla monster drops into Shop6, for days when you want to craft or build without going monster hunting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get is slime, bug meat, bat wing, solar essence, and void essence. All vanilla items, no new sprites and no config. Stock is unlimited, so you can buy a few for a recipe or a whole stack for crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You will need Kenneth's Grocery Store installed, since this addon only adds items to its Shop6. It also needs Content Patcher to run. It shares Shop6 with the Mine Loot Addon, so if you have both installed, you will see both sets of items in the same shop.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install is the usual flow. Drop this folder into your Mods folder together with Kenneth's Grocery Store, then start the game. If Shop6 looks empty, check that the base Grocery Store mod is enabled first.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Made for players who want to skip the combat grind sometimes and just buy the monster loot they need for crafting, quests, and building.[/b][/size]
